attributes.action: Rethink workplace pensions in the age of AI
attributes.background:
Workers should have the freedom to decide whether they want to contribute to a pension, rather than having a legal requirement to put their hard-earned money into a system designed around assumptions about the future of money that may no longer apply due to AI.

Our money, our future, our choice.

rejection.details:
Employees already have the right to opt out of workplace pension schemes.

Employers are legally required to automatically enrol eligible workers into a workplace pension scheme, but employees can choose to opt out and stop making contributions.

You can find more information here:

https://www.gov.uk/workplace-pensions/if-you-want-to-leave-your-workplace-pension-scheme
